observations.locator: PDF page 1 heading and specifications; pages 1-2 performance notice
observations.observation: Duracell MN1500 AA, alkaline manganese dioxide, nominal 1.5 V and flat terminals. Delivered capacity depends on load, temperature and cutoff; no scalar capacity was taken from a chart. All capacity fields remain null.

Major AA cells fall within the described alkaline family. Composition specifies zinc negative electrode and manganese dioxide positive electrode; recharge is identified as abusive handling. Regional company contacts do not establish an exact factory.

observations.locator: PDF page 1 heading and specifications; pages 1-2 capacity dependence notice and footer
observations.observation: Duracell Ultra MX2500 AAAA, alkaline manganese dioxide, nominal 1.5 V and flat terminals. No chart-derived scalar capacity is imported. Footer code MX25US0216 is retained; the URL filename has an extra final digit, which is not used as a document revision.

Specialty AAAA cells are covered by physical description. Recharge warning supports non-rechargeable classification. Ultra is not separately enumerated in the Global Sub-brands list; applicability uses the explicit specialty AAAA physical description.
The exact MX2500 PDF is linked for North America and also Europe/Africa. Selection of the North America listing is supported; no exclusive regional product claim is made.

observations.locator: PDF page 1 Performance Specs, Configuration Options and Dimensions; page 3 Charging and footer
observations.observation: Exact PS-640 is a general-purpose sealed lead-acid assembled battery. Nominal voltage is 6.0 V, distinct from charging instructions. Nominal capacity is 4.5 Ah at the 20-hour row, 0.23 A to 5.25 V, so 4500 mAh with nominal basis is correct. Other rate rows are neither minimum nor typical capacity. F1 is the explicit listed configuration. Page 3 charging supports rechargeable classification. Version 1.2, updated 8/18/2026 4:24 PM, matches the actual opened PDF; older search results are not substituted.

observations.locator: PDF page 1 Performance Specs, Configuration Options and Dimensions; page 3 Charging and footer
observations.observation: Exact PS-1208 is a sealed lead-acid assembled battery. Nominal voltage is 12.0 V. Nominal capacity is 0.8 Ah at the 20-hour row, 0.04 A to 10.5 V, so 800 mAh with nominal basis is correct. Configuration Options separately lists PS-1208 WL, PS-1208 FR WL and PS-1208 JST VHR-2N. The selected WL option is explicit; JST/FR is not selected. Pin polarity and detailed terminal dimensions remain unknown. Version 1.2, updated 8/18/2026 4:29 PM, matches the actual PDF.

issues.observation: The chemistry observation refers to the zinc negative electrode and AIS corroboration, but currently cites only the product PDF chemical-system locator. AIS page 1 Section 4 explicitly states the electrode composition.
issues.recommended_action: Add an AIS page 1 Section 4 evidence entry to /chemistry, or limit the product-PDF observation to its stated alkaline manganese dioxide/Zn-MnO2 chemical system. No numeric or chemistry classification correction is needed.
issues.resolution: All five Duracell chemistry evidence arrays now include AIS page 1 Sections 3/4, with product-PDF observation limited to its stated chemical system. This chemistry-only expansion does not increase the four full core samples.

validation.method: Current catalog_tool.py schema_errors on each source/model and validate_data on an in-memory catalog plus fragment, with in-memory published_on 2026-10-03. No canonical or report file written.

limitations: The other seven product data sheets were not independently reopened for full core audit. All eleven rows received local schema/semantic checks; the three additional Duracell rows received chemistry-evidence applicability review only.
Duracell MN1500 and MX2500 have no curated scalar capacity. Their verified identity/chemistry/voltage does not imply known capacity or a complete numeric capacity prefill.
The AIS does not separately list Ultra in its sub-brand list; the exact specialty AAAA physical-description coverage and product-specific alkaline sheet support MX2500 classification.
PDF text, specification tables and variant-option text were read; graphical capacity points and terminal diagrams were not digitized. No capacity or detailed connector geometry is claimed from them.

The selected Power-Sonic capacity rows do not separately state test temperature. Charging temperature and generic 12 V charging guidance are not substituted as capacity conditions or PS-640 nominal voltage.
No source establishes a particular received battery, factory, school purchase, condition or compatibility. Publisher identification is not used to fill manufacturer.
notes: No core discrepancy or alias product conflation was found in the four full samples. A chemistry citation precision issue was expanded to all five Duracell rows, corrected by the root researcher, and independently checked in the current fragment.
Actual opened current Power-Sonic PDF version 1.2 takes precedence over search-engine older version 1.1 snippets.
This audit edits only its new review artifact.
